author: fictional_hn_user
title: Megathread about hiring, visas and layoffs in tech (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE)

children.author: fictional_commenter_a
children.text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: invented comment. A fictional rival firm was sued in a class action over visa fraud and discrimination against local staff. The fraud allegations led to an investigation by regulators, a hefty fine and a settlement. There were layoffs, a data breach, a ransomware outage and a boycott, and the scandal caused a backlash and criticism. Shares fell, margins declined and auditors resigned amid the controversy.

children.author: fictional_commenter_b
children.text: Another invented firm faced bribery claims, antitrust scrutiny, tariffs, sanctions and a trade secrets lawsuit. Workers complained about unpaid overtime, toxic culture and forced resignation. Nobody here has seen anything like it.

children.author: fictional_commenter_c
children.text: Somebody mentioned TCS once as one of many outsourcing vendors. It was a throwaway remark about bench staff and nothing else.
